articles.title: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals Announces Health Canada Approval of REDEMPLO™ (plozasiran) to Reduce Triglycerides in Adults with Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS)
articles.mainIdea: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals Announces Health Canada Approval of REDEMPLO™ (plozasiran) to Reduce Triglycerides in Adults with Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS)
articles.summary: Business Wire: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals Announces Health Canada Approval of REDEMPLO™ (plozasiran) to Reduce Triglycerides in Adults with Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS). PASADENA, Calif., January 05, 2026--Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: ARWR) today announced that Health Canada has issued a Notice of Compliance (NOC) authorizing REDEMPLO™ (plozasiran), a small interfering RNA (siRNA) medicine, as an adjunct to diet to reduce triglycerides in adults with familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS) for whom standard triglyceride lowering therapies have been inadequate.
